body_html:
Comfort that earns its keep, shift after shift. The Part-Time task chair pairs contoured cushions and a waterfall seat edge with full task-mechanism control, so administrative teams, classrooms, and clinic back-offices get genuine ergonomic support without stretching the budget. Proudly made in Canada by Global Furniture Group, it's an easy specify for buyers who need durable, value-priced seating in volume.

Features

  • Task control mechanism for responsive recline and tilt
  • Seat depth adjustment to suit a range of body sizes
  • Height-adjustable T-arms with durable self-skinned urethane armcaps
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment, 16.5"–21.5"
  • Contoured cushions with a waterfall seat edge that reduces pressure behind the knees
  • Dual-wheel carpet casters
  • Available in all Grade 1 seating textiles, or bleach-cleanable Bantam vinyl

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 26.5"W x 24.5"D x 36.5"H with a 16.5"–21.5" seat-height range, a 300 lb weight rating, and a chair weight of 39 lbs. The Part-Time series is GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certified and meets ANSI/BIFMA LEVEL standards, backed by a 5-year warranty, with 15 years on the metal frame.

As a family-owned OECM-eligible supplier since 1964, Brant Business Interiors helps Ontario school boards, hospitals, and municipalities purchase this Canadian-made seating without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing, or call 1-800-835-9565.
